name: Shanghai Jahwa United Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Jahwa United Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of daily chemical products, and baby products in the People's Republic of China and internationally. It offers skin care, cleaning, home care, and infant feeding products under the Liushen, Yuze, Herborist, Maxam, GUOFU, Jiaan, Qichu, and Tommee Tippee brands. The company also provides technical services for daily chemicals and cosmetics.
